comments.body: Hmm, I don't think we should include these here. IMO it's good for each repo to have the archive links for its calls. If you want to just reference these two repos, perhaps we can do it, but I'm also mindful of making things more complex than they already are...!
I meant specifically only including links in the readme (for discoverability purposes)
